verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator with a PyTorch/vLLM software stack. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is an access-management capability of a service or platform, so the question is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence also shows no first-party credential system; the cloud-access mention refers to a hosting platform, not to Gaudi itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
